slides.title: Nature listens first
slides.body: Animals survive not by making the first sound, but by listening first. Only then do they call out.

slides.title: More than waiting your turn
slides.body: Set aside the reply forming in your mind. Give your full attention to what's being said.

slides.title: Hear what isn't said
slides.body: Hesitation, silence, context. The meaning beneath the words.

slides.title: Quiet isn't weakness
slides.body: It's discipline. It takes confidence to admit someone else may know something you don't.

slides.title: Enter the room ready to receive.
slides.body: "The Wisdom of Speaking Less" on the Journal at pathways2goodlife.com
